name: Launchpad Set
source: Level 3 parts boxes (lp_plans 3-1 to 3-14) sum to 74, plus 5 floor plates (lp_plans_00) = 79; plus one M-07 tray, which Level 3 never uses but the manual shows with its own sticker (launchpad.pdf p4 sticker 4, p5 render): 80 building pieces. Retail listings say 89 with 10 marbles (79): one piece unexplained, see openQuestion.
